3.speaker: Lucita Azaro
3.text: "Despite the fire damage, we were able to trace them back to CircuitRise Systems, an electronics manufacturer in Pales. Its main contractor is the government of the Grand Duchy."

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "Has there been any news regarding the Zille bombing?"

5.speaker: Lucita Azaro
5.text: "Excellent! I'll promptly deliver the results of the investigation to you as soon as they're available."

7.speaker: Lucita Azaro
7.text: "In my opinion, the evidence we found more than justifies a closer investigation into the Palesian connection."

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Lucita handed me a sheet of paper from her dossier.

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "I expect you have some news for me regarding Iza."

15.speaker: Hugo Toras
15.text: "Your Majesty, the situation in Iza remains fraught with challenges."

16.speaker: Lucita Azaro
16.text: "Unfortunately, no. The evidence on the possible culprit continues to be circumstantial at best."

17.speaker: Lucita Azaro
17.text: "Wehlen continues to blame the bombing on Su Omina, despite their unwillingness to provide definitive proof of their accusations."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "It's infuriating to think that Su Omina might be falsely accused."

19.speaker: Hugo Toras
19.text: "I too share your concerns. It's imperative that we tread carefully and not play into Wehlen's hands."

23.speaker: Hugo Toras
23.text: "The last thing we need is an escalation of violence."

27.speaker: Lucita Azaro
27.text: "We're seeing increased violence, and there have been reports of clashes in the streets."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Following your advice, Lucita, I refrained from deploying Central Police to Iza. It seems that decision has backfired."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "I knew it was a mistake not to strengthen the police presence."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Well, it appears that my cousin is incapable of handling the situation himself."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "This is being blown way out of proportion. I'm sure the situation isn't as critical as it seems."

35.speaker: Hugo Toras
35.text: "My son's ability to govern is without question. It is the lack of resources that hinders him."

36.speaker: Lucita Azaro
36.text: "I still stand by my recommendation. Given what we've seen so far, handing the Duke extra units would be a disaster."

37.speaker: Hugo Toras
37.text: "One that can be easily rectified, Your Majesty."

38.speaker: Lucita Azaro
38.text: "With all due respect, it is. It must be immediately dealt with before it spirals out of control."

40.speaker: Lucita Azaro
40.text: "However, we can't stand by and do nothing."

41.speaker: Hugo Toras
41.text: "In any case, we must do something to tackle this situation."

44.speaker: Lucita Azaro
44.text: "Thanks to your willingness to further fund our intelligence capabilities, our team in Wehlen was able to locate and identify material used in the explosive device."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "So Duke Reinhart planned the bombing? Why am I not surprised?"

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I wouldn't have expected the Palesians to be involved."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Pales and Rizia have had our ups and downs, but I have a hard time believing Reinhart would take such drastic action."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "That doesn't mean anything. Those parts could've been ordered by someone in Rizia, Wehlen or anywhere else."

49.speaker: Lucita Azaro
49.text: "The evidence is far from airtight, Your Majesty. But it's enough to merit further investigation."

50.speaker: Lucita Azaro
50.text: "We don't know for a fact that they were. I believe further investigation is warranted."

51.speaker: Lucita Azaro
51.text: "I understand your reservations. But I believe that this evidence warrants further investigation at the very least."

52.speaker: Lucita Azaro
52.text: "I don't think so. CircuitRise is subject to strict export controls by the Palesian authorities. If it shipped the parts out of the country, it did so illegally."

53.speaker: Lucita Azaro
53.text: "Just say the word, Your Majesty, and I'll immediately direct our efforts towards a more extensive investigation of Pales."

54.speaker: Lucita Azaro
54.text: "Very well. I'll be sure to share the investigation findings with you as soon as something turns up."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "I understand your concern about Wehlen, Hugo, but I believe we have no other choice but to shift focus and make Pales our number one priority." [-1 Budget]

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "I've heard enough. I'm giving the royal order for your investigators to switch their focus to Pales." [-1 Authority]

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Thank you, Duchess. However, like Hugo, I think we should concentrate our resources on Wehlen. The idea of Pales' involvement in the bombing doesn't add up." [-1 Budget]

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Unfortunately, they very well might be right."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "All the more reason to clamp down on their activities."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "I agree with Lucita. We need to approach this situation by considering all perspectives."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "While we may not agree on everything, I must insist that we speak to one another respectfully."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "Will you two knock it off? This bickering is getting us nowhere."

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "Agreed. However, we shouldn't dismiss the possibility of Su Omina's involvement just because the evidence is lacking."

66.speaker: Hugo Toras
66.text: "No offense, Duchess Azaro, but you've had your sights set on Su Omina for some time."

67.speaker: Lucita Azaro
67.text: "Because I'm willing to look at the situation from all angles, and don't share your biased sympathies."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Good. Now what else have you got?"

69.speaker: Lucita Azaro
69.text: "That's all the information I have given the limitations of my investigation."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "Moving on... The last time this came up, we discussed fingerprints found at the scene of the crime. Can I assume there's been no further updates?"

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "Unfortunately, that clue has reached a dead end, and we haven't received any further information from Wehlen."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Wehlen provided information that ultimately led us nowhere. Why am I not surprised?"

80.speaker: Hugo Toras
80.text: "With Wehlen, nothing ever comes as a surprise."

82.speaker: Lucita Azaro
82.text: "We've run them through our databases more times than I can count, but they still turned up nothing. I'm afraid we've hit a dead end."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "That's unfortunate. Not that I had high expectations for it to yield results."

84.speaker: Hugo Toras
84.text: "I had a feeling it wouldn't either."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Damn. I really thought that might lead somewhere."

86.speaker: Hugo Toras
86.text: "I never expected much to come of it."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "Anyway, what of the fingerprints found at the scene of the crime? Any further updates with that?"

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Let's continue... I seem to remember fingerprints being found at the scene of the crime."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Is that it or is there anything else you wish to share with the class?"

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "Let's delve into our counter-terrorism agreement with Wehlen."
91.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)

95.speaker: Lucita Azaro
95.text: "Yes. I'd first like to discuss our participation in Wehlen's anti-terrorist campaign against the Bludish Freedom Front and its sympathizers."

97.speaker: Lucita Azaro
97.text: "There isn't much to report, but it's worth mentioning that there's been a surge of Bludish migrants attempting to cross the Gulf of Moridia."

98.speaker: Hugo Toras
98.text: "About time something was finally done about them."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "For the sake of our own security, action had to be taken."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I wouldn't have involved Rizia in this fight if I had the choice. It's an unfortunate situation we find ourselves in. Please continue."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "I disagree, but don't wish to further debate the issue. Not now, at least. Please continue, Lucita."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "I'm skeptical about whether it will achieve the goals Smolak hopes this will accomplish, but time will tell."

104.speaker: Lucita Azaro
104.text: "To get back to the point... while a deal has been reached, it won't go into effect until Smolak initiates the necessary steps, which we believe will happen soon."

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "Because of this, we've already taken preliminary measures to prepare ourselves for such a possibility."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "What kind of preliminary measures? I don't like the sound of that."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "Good. I'm glad we're being proactive on this."

109.speaker: Lucita Azaro
109.text: "First, by ensuring our border guards have everything they need at their disposal so they can execute their duties without hindrance."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "I hate that it's to come to this, but we must do what has to be done. Please continue."

114.speaker: Lucita Azaro
114.text: "I've been working with the royal navy to boost their patrol capabilities in our territorial waters, aiding vessels already on duty."

115.speaker: Lucita Azaro
115.text: "They'll be tasked with intercepting any ships trying to cross the Gulf of Moridia from Wehlen. We anticipate a veritable flotilla of them."

116.speaker: Lucita Azaro
116.text: "They were apparently trying to reach our shores. An investigation is still underway, but so far only 30 of an estimated 500 survived."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "My God... that's awful. What a terrible tragedy."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "My thoughts are with the survivors and their families."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "That's unfortunate. However, they should have known better than to gamble with their lives."

120.speaker: Lucita Azaro
120.text: "It's been reported that an overcrowded Bludish migrant ship capsized in the Gulf just this morning after being turned away by one of our patrol vessels in the area."

121.speaker: Lucita Azaro
121.text: "Excuse me... *perform* their duties without hindrance. In addition to border security..."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "Agreed. Traversing such a dangerous and unforgiving waterway feels like tempting fate."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "When people hit rock bottom and have nothing to lose, they're more likely to take extreme measures."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "Neither can I. I wouldn't risk it even if someone held a gun to my head."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "Same. If I were in their shoes, I'd stand up and fight back."

126.speaker: Hugo Toras
126.text: "I'll never understand what compels people to board such ships in the first place."

127.speaker: Lucita Azaro
127.text: "As you're aware, this will necessitate temporarily redeploying ships from our gas field blockade."

135.speaker: Lucita Azaro
135.text: "Having covered that, I believe I've touched upon all the key aspects of this issue--"

138.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
138.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_IzaUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_ZilleBombUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_AntiMonarchyUnrest"] == true

139.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
139.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_IzaUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_ZilleBombUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_AntiMonarchyUnrest"] == true) == false

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "Well, if there's nothing left to discuss, let us adjourn."
140.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_IzaUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_ZilleBombUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_AntiMonarchyUnrest"] == true

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: Hugo rose from his seat and stretched his arms back.

142.speaker: Hugo Toras
142.text: "Just in time. My joints were starting to stiffen."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: Hugo silently signaled his farewell before exiting the room.

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "I take it the meeting wasn't adjourned after all."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "Looks like I have you all to myself."

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: I allowed my gaze to travel down her figure, savoring every detail.

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: I not-so-discretely drifted my gaze down her figure.

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: I subtly let my gaze wander down her form.

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: Lucita struggled to suppress a smile, but one still managed to slip through.

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "A proper date... and maybe a little more..."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "Off the record, that may not be the only proper thing I owe you..."

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: Her cheeks flushed red as she struggled to fight back a smile.

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: Her face flushed red as she battled to restrain a grin.

159.speaker: Lucita Azaro
159.text: "Hate to disappoint, but the only reason I stayed behind was to remind you that you still owed me a proper date."

160.speaker: Lucita Azaro
160.text: "Anyway... That's all I wanted to say. Seeing as how it's an urgent security matter, I expect to hear back from you soon."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "I don't like being rushed. But I'll let you know soon enough."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "How can I say no? Seeing how it's an 'urgent security matter...'"

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: There was a subtle look of disappointment in her eye, but only briefly.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: Before long, I was alone with my thoughts.

171.speaker: Lucita Azaro
171.text: "I'm looking forward to it. Goodnight, Your Majesty."

172.speaker: Hugo Toras
172.text: "What would you like to discuss first?"

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: I sat in my designated seat at the head of the table.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: Hugo, Lucita, and Titus rose to their feet the moment I stepped into the council chambers.

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "Is there a particular reason we can attribute to this increase?"

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "My heart goes out to them, but given our limited resources, I'm hesitant to welcome these migrants with open arms."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Why now? Does it relate to Wehlen's anti-Bludish campaign?"

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "These Bludish migrants have become a constant source of frustration."

180.speaker: Lucita Azaro
180.text: "While we haven't observed a significant push, we're aware that they're conducting covert operations to suppress Bludish communities within their borders."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "Wehlen is testing us. Smolak knows that any sudden increase in migration will put a strain on our resources."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "It can't be a coincidence that increase in migration coincides with my decision not to assist Wehlen's campaign of oppression."

183.speaker: Hugo Toras
183.text: "Taking advantage of Rizia's open borders. Perhaps we should have agreed on Mr. Smolak's Bludish ban after all."

184.speaker: Hugo Toras
184.text: "That's certainly a possibility, however, we mustn't assume anything. It could just be a coincidence."

185.speaker: Hugo Toras
185.text: "We can't say for sure, but is certainly something to consider."

186.speaker: Lucita Azaro
186.text: "Speaking of which... just this morning, one of our patrol vessels intercepted an overcrowded Bludish migrant ship crossing the Gulf."

187.speaker: Lucita Azaro
187.text: "Thank you. As I was saying, although an agreement has been reached, it won't become active until Smolak initiates the necessary steps, which we believe will happen soon."

188.speaker: Lucita Azaro
188.text: "Of course. Anyway, our agreement with Smolak remains inactive until he takes the necessary actions to set it in motion, which we believe will happen soon."

190.speaker: Lucita Azaro
190.text: "Anyway, our agreement with Smolak won't come into effect until he takes the required steps to set it in motion, which we believe will happen soon."

193.speaker: Hugo Toras
193.text: "Let's hope you never find yourself in such a situation."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "I'd like to discuss our resistance efforts in Zille."

202.speaker: Lucita Azaro
202.text: "I'm pleased to report that our funding to Su Omina has commenced without a hitch."

203.speaker: Lucita Azaro
203.text: "They've been using the resources wisely, primarily for procuring weapons and establishing supply lines."

204.speaker: Lucita Azaro
204.text: "We haven't initiated any major operations as of yet, but our preparations are well underway."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Are they following the strategies we discussed?"

206.speaker: Lucita Azaro
206.text: "Su Omina is focusing on guerrilla warfare, sabotage of essential services, and slowly building support among the local population."

207.speaker: Lucita Azaro
207.text: "Strategically, they are taking a patient, calculated approach to yield the best results."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "Excellent. Our objectives to regain control of Zille from Wehlen's grasp are clear."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "What kind of operations? I do worry about this escalating into a situation that spirals out of control."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "These types of heavy-handed operations don't sit well with me. Unfortunately, I fear they may be our only choice."

212.speaker: Hugo Toras
212.text: "Knowing Su Omina like I do, they are resolute in their mission to reunite Zille with Rizia."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "Good. In the long run, that often leads to more enduring success."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "Well said. I have no doubt Zille will once again return to our fold."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "Let us hope Su Omina shares that sentiment."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "Very well. Stay vigilant and monitor the situation closely."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "We must also consider the urgency of the matter. Waiting too long to take decisive action could make the situation more complicated."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "I have decided that ending the investigation will serve us better in the long term."

222.speaker: Lucita Azaro
222.text: "End it?! Your Majesty, may I ask why?"

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Please just trust me on this, Duchess."

227.speaker: Narrator
227.text: My return journey from Morella had just concluded, and within hours of being back on Rizian soil, I was called for an internal security meeting.

228.speaker: Hugo Toras
228.text: "Yes, thanks for coming on such short notice. I know you must have many other pressing appointments."

229.speaker: Lucita Azaro
229.text: "Good evening, Your Majesty. I'm glad you could join us."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "If I do, they're absolutely none of your business."

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: My remark elicited hearty laughter from Hugo, while Lucita responded with a more reserved chuckle.

232.speaker: Hugo Toras
232.text: "Tempting, if that were true, but I'm afraid that my sense of humor might be considered a touch passé. Lucita, on the other hand..."

233.speaker: Lucita Azaro
233.text: "Thanks, but I'll pass. Humor has never been my strong suit."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "But in all seriousness, I'm still exhausted from my recent visit to Morella and could use some downtime."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Joking aside, I'd prefer not to spend the remainder of my evening in meetings."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "Too bad. Anyway, as much as I like looking at your beautiful faces, let's wrap this up soon."

237.speaker: Lucita Azaro
237.text: "Of course. We'll do our best to get through everything as quickly as possible."

238.speaker: Lucita Azaro
238.text: "Very well. We'll do our best to expedite matters."

239.speaker: Lucita Azaro
239.text: "Of course. We'll make it as brief as possible."

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: I let my eyes linger on Lucita for a moment. Her struggle to hide a grin told me my subtle flirtation was well received.

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "I mean, not *all* the crown jewels... Just the ones I don't care for."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "I said I'm considering it. Calm down."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Of course! History has shown that excessive decadence has undone many kings and queens."

252.speaker: Lucita Azaro
252.text: "Did you have a charity in mind?"

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "Possibly a faith-based organization -- one that does charitable work in underserved communities."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Something related to the arts in order to project a more cultured image of myself."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "We're getting off-track. Let's save this discussion for another time."

261.speaker: Hugo Toras
261.text: "I love God as much as the next Wruhecist, but as your Grand Vizier, I strongly protest giving away a portion of the treasury to him."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "This can be a topic for future discussion should I decide to proceed."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "Well, there's always more love to give."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: Lucita grinned, while Hugo's smile was clearly fake.

270.speaker: Hugo Toras
270.text: "Good. I do hope you keep it that way and reconsider such a proposal."

271.speaker: Lucita Azaro
271.text: "It's said that cultivating a cultured image can enhance one's appeal. Or so I've heard."

275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
275.text: "Expanding your appreciation for the arts is a great way to enrich your life. Or so I've heard. Unfortunately, my schedule doesn't often permit such indulgences..."

276.speaker: Narrator
276.text: There was a hint of playfulness in her voice that didn't go unnoticed by me. Thankfully, Hugo remained blissfully unaware.

277.speaker: Hugo Toras
277.text: "Well, I do hope you don't follow through with this scheme. For the sake of the monarchy."

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: Hugo, Lucita, and Titus took their respective seats. Aides placed folders full of information in front of each of us, and glasses of water were poured.

279.speaker: Hugo Toras
279.text: "Of course. I didn't mean to pry."

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: After saying their goodbyes, Hugo and Lucita took their leave.
280.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn03_Security_TitusLeadsInvestigation"] == true) == false)

281.speaker: Narrator
281.text: We'd concluded the briefing in a timely manner.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: The weight of our internal security discussions still lingered in the air as I stood alone in the room.

289.speaker: Narrator
289.text: With a somber nod to the vacant chairs, I departed, ready to face the responsibilities that lay beyond the meeting room.

293.speaker: Hugo Toras
293.text: "Sure, but even if they are guilty, it doesn't mean we back up Wehlen's claim."

294.speaker: Hugo Toras
294.text: "I have no doubt. They've been gunning Su Omina for quite some time, with the clear goal of dismantling them."

295.speaker: Hugo Toras
295.text: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, we should carefully assess the situation before taking any drastic measures."

296.speaker: Hugo Toras
296.text: "Well, I still say that we should avoid pointing fingers prematurely."

299.speaker: Lucita Azaro
299.text: "First, by ensuring that our border guards have all the necessary resources at their disposal so that they may carry out their duties without hindrance."

300.speaker: Lucita Azaro
300.text: "To start with, we're ensuring that our border guards have access to all the resources they require to help them perform to the best of their abilities."

302.speaker: Lucita Azaro
302.text: "We've got everything under control. You can count on that. As for their preparations..."

303.speaker: Hugo Toras
303.text: "I agree. We must act quickly to address immediate concerns."

304.speaker: Hugo Toras
304.text: "Yes, but we mustn't wait too long. It's important that we also address immediate concerns."

306.speaker: Hugo Toras
306.text: "Apart from denying them the satisfaction of being correct, it risks escalating tensions between our nations even further."

307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
307.text: "Yes, however, we shouldn't dismiss the possibility of Su Omina's involvement just because the evidence is lacking."

308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
308.text: "I concur. Nevertheless, we shouldn't rule out Su Omina's potential involvement simply because the evidence is lacking."

309.speaker: Hugo Toras
309.text: "Given the lack of concrete evidence, the last thing we want is a witch hunt on our hands."

310.speaker: Lucita Azaro
310.text: "Sure, but, we shouldn't dismiss the possibility of Su Omina's involvement just because the evidence is lacking."

311.speaker: Lucita Azaro
311.text: "While that may be, I'm still fully capable of taking an objective approach when evaluating a situation."

313.speaker: Lucita Azaro
313.text: "While we haven't observed a significant push, we know they're conducting covert operations to suppress Bludish communities within their borders."

314.speaker: Lucita Azaro
314.text: "Well, if it weren't for Wehlen's covert operations against the Bludish communities within their borders, this likely wouldn't even be an issue."

315.speaker: Lucita Azaro
315.text: "While we haven't observed a significant push, we're aware that they're conducting covert operations to suppress Bludish communities within their borders."

318.speaker: Lucita Azaro
318.text: "From what we can tell, Wehlen is responsible for the situation in the first place."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Even though these types of heavy-handed operations don't sit well with me, they may produce the best results."

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: Lucita gave a brief, affirming nod.

327.speaker: Hugo Toras
327.text: "I have no doubt that they'll live up to their expectations."

329.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "Actually, I think that's enough briefing for today. Let's adjourn."
331.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_IzaUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_ZilleBombUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_AntiMonarchyUnrest"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_IzaUpdate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_ZilleBombUpdate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_BorderSecurityUpdate"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_AntiMonarchyUnrest"] == true)

333.speaker: Hugo Toras
333.text: "No objection from me. I wouldn't mind getting to bed early tonight anyway."

344.speaker: Titus Gordion
344.text: "Upon a careful examination, I've discovered that there is indeed evidence linking Su Omina to the incident."

345.speaker: Titus Gordion
345.text: "However, their involvement is quite different from what I believe any of us were expecting."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "I highly doubt that. But please continue."

347.speaker: Titus Gordion
347.text: "We managed to obtain samples of certain materials produced by this plant. A thorough examination revealed an exact match with the residue found at the bombing site."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "So there *is* a direct link to Su Omina."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "Interesting. And would the company or employee happen to have any ties to the Duke of Iza?"

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "Well, don't leave me waiting. Spit it out."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "I have my doubts about this, Titus. While Su Omina may be vehemently against Wehlen's occupation of Zille, they would never resort to terrorism."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "I assigned you this investigation to clear Su Omina's name, not sully it."

358.speaker: Titus Gordion
358.text: "Of course, further investigation is needed in order to establish a definitive link between the Zille bombing, the organization and the factory employee in question."

359.speaker: Titus Gordion
359.text: "Despite being located in Rizia, the fertilizer plant is, in fact, state-owned by Pales."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "I knew it! I had a feeling Pales was behind it all along."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "I see what you're implying. However, the likelihood of Su Omina acting independently -- unrelated to Pales -- seems more likely."

364.speaker: Titus Gordion
364.text: "I'm sure that the plant is owned by Pales. As for their involvement with the bombing, I can't say for certain."

365.speaker: Titus Gordion
365.text: "In short, we've identified a Su Omina member with ties to employment at a fertilizer plant, TerraGrowth Agrochem, located outside of Iza."

366.speaker: Titus Gordion
366.text: "I know it may be difficult to believe, but the facts speak for themselves.."

367.speaker: Titus Gordion
367.text: "I apologize, Your Majesty, but this evidence does seem to indicate the organization's involvement."

368.speaker: Titus Gordion
368.text: "One of the Su Omina members my team was surveilling is employed at a fertilizer plant just outside of Iza. TerraGrowth Agrochem."

369.speaker: Titus Gordion
369.text: "Not that I've come across, but Duke Ricardus' involvement cannot be ruled out yet. Further investigation is needed."

370.speaker: Titus Gordion
370.text: "I was just about to bring that up, Duchess Azaro."

371.speaker: Titus Gordion
371.text: "Yes, I agree. I don't believe Pales had anything to do with the attacks."

372.speaker: Titus Gordion
372.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, that isn't the conclusion I would jump to."

373.speaker: Titus Gordion
373.text: "I agree with you completely. I believe the Pales connection is a red herring."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "Why, yes. I'm toying with the idea of auctioning some of the Crown Jewels for charity, and I thought I'd check them out first."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "After such a taxing board meeting, I'd like to unwind with a glass of Romus the Red."
375.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_WineWhiskeyDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_RebelKing"] == true) == false)

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "After such a taxing board meeting, I'd like to unwind with a glass of Sordish whisky."
376.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_WineWhiskeyDeal"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_RebelKing"] == true) == false)

377.speaker: Hugo Toras
377.text: "A fine vintage, if I do say so myself."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "I don't want to be late to the Wruhecist Tabernacle Choir performance this evening."

380.speaker: Player_Romus
380.text: "Auditions for the court jester are tonight. You should come. Or better yet, try out!"

396.speaker: Hugo Toras
396.text: "We'll be sure you'll make it on time."

397.speaker: Titus Gordion
397.text: "Nor should you. Having attended one of their performances last year, I guarantee you won't be disappointed."

401.speaker: Narrator
401.text: Lucita and I exchanged a brief glance before looking away.

402.speaker: Narrator
402.text: Everyone directed their glance toward Titus.

405.speaker: Hugo Toras
405.text: "But yes, let's proceed. Far be it for me to keep you from such an indulgence."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "It's possible the bombing was part of a larger strategy to establish themselves as a dominant power in the region."

407.speaker: Player_Romus
407.text: "If the Palesians were responsible, it must have had something to do with the Aureus gas field."

408.speaker: Hugo Toras
408.text: "That would track with their aggressive pursuit of the Aureus gas field."

409.speaker: Lucita Azaro
409.text: "Yes, I doubt it was a coincidence that the bombing occurred in the middle of the gas field explorations."

410.speaker: Lucita Azaro
410.text: "Uncovering conclusive proof that Pales planned the Friendship Day attack would surely help us win the arbitration case."

411.speaker: Hugo Toras
411.text: "Tell me, Duchess Azaro. What would Pales have to gain from masterminding the Friendship Day incident?"

413.speaker: Lucita Azaro
413.text: "I think that the attack coming in the middle of the preliminary explorations for the Aureus gas field was no coincidence."

414.speaker: Lucita Azaro
414.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. I'll warn you that it may be some time before we get results."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: The tension in the atmosphere was clear, but nobody voiced their opposition.

416.speaker: Lucita Azaro
416.text: "Would it, Captain Gordion? There is no evidence that the suspect in question was responsible for smuggling those materials out of the plant."

418.speaker: Hugo Toras
418.text: "As I have mentioned multiple times, my son was not involved in this heinous act. I can vouch for him personally."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "As king, I'm allowed to broach any subject matter I see fit. If that's going to be a problem..."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "Does that mean you were with him on Friendship Day?"

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "Given his involvement with Su Omina, I'd say my inquiry has merit."

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "Relax, Uncle. I didn't mean to imply that Rico had anything to do with it."

423.speaker: Hugo Toras
423.text: "I certainly hope not. I remain convinced that Captain Gordion is better off exploring other avenues of investigation."

424.speaker: Lucita Azaro
424.text: "His Majesty does have a point, Your Grace. We cannot completely write off the Duke of Iza as a suspect."

425.speaker: Titus Gordion
425.text: "I can answer that. Duke Ricardus spent that day in his palace. He had no personal contact with Duke Toras or anyone else, though we have no record of any phone calls he made that day."

429.speaker: Hugo Toras
429.text: "No, Your Majesty. I meant no offense. All I'm saying is that the investigation would be better spent focusing on other aspects of the case, not Ricardus' involvement."

431.speaker: Lucita Azaro
431.text: "Well, what we *can* be certain about is that this may warrant a closer investigation into their activities in the region."

432.speaker: Hugo Toras
432.text: "I maintain my belief that the explosion was set up to frame Su Omina and the Rizian nationalist movement. However, I am not convinced that the Palesian government was involved, either."

433.speaker: Titus Gordion
433.text: "I'll deliver the results of the investigation to you as soon as they're available."

434.speaker: Hugo Toras
434.text: "Great! I have no doubt any lingering suspicions against Su Omina will be will be resolved."

435.speaker: Narrator
435.text: The tension in the atmosphere was clear. Finally, Hugo spoke.

436.speaker: Titus Gordion
436.text: "I will not completely dismiss the validity of Duchess Azaro's argument. But I personally don't believe a further investigation into the Palesian connection is warranted."

437.speaker: Lucita Azaro
437.text: "We shouldn't ignore this possibility. If Pales is involved, it would escalate our relationship to a new and dangerous level."

438.speaker: Lucita Azaro
438.text: "Nor I. But I do believe the Pales connection warrants further investigation."

439.speaker: Lucita Azaro
439.text: "While coincidences can happen, we shouldn't dismiss the possibility of a deeper connection."

447.speaker: Lucita Azaro
447.text: "Perhaps it's time for that to change, Captain Gordion. The Golden Guard may be able to carry out small-scale investigations, but the geopolitical implications of this one strike me as beyond your team's purview."

448.speaker: Hugo Toras
448.text: "Either way, we will have to channel more resources into this investigation in order for it to continue."

449.speaker: Titus Gordion
449.text: "Unlike Hugo, I believe Su Omina's involvement can't be ignored, and we should dive deeper into their operations."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "With all due respect, Captain, I trust my security councilor's assessment of the situation."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "You're allowed to say it, Captain Gordion. My security councilor is talking nonsense."

452.speaker: Lucita Azaro
452.text: "Pales may well be innocent. But given our history with them, determining their exact role in all this should be our top priority."

453.speaker: Player_Romus
453.text: "It's exactly as warranted as a further investigation into Su Omina. We've established motives for both."

454.speaker: Lucita Azaro
454.text: "You're right, Your Majesty. But given the importance of keeping the peace with Pales, I think determining their government's guilt or innocence should be our top priority."

455.speaker: Hugo Toras
455.text: "I agree with the Duchess. If there's even the slightest possibility Pales may have engineered this, we need to get to the bottom of it."

456.speaker: Titus Gordion
456.text: "Duchess Azaro's expertise in matters of security is beyond question. However, she has spent little time with this particular case."

457.speaker: Lucita Azaro
457.text: "I think both options have their merits, but I'm inclined to investigate Pales."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "Could you outline the possible ramifications of continuing to focus the investigation on Su Omina?"
458.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_SORepercussions"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 1)) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_Palesrepercussions"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSOAndPales"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "And if we decided to put a stop to the investigation entirely? What would happen then?"
459.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSOAndPales"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_Palesrepercussions"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSOAndPales"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

460.speaker: Hugo Toras
460.text: "Needless to say, Your Majesty, the investigation has ruffled some feathers within the organization."

461.speaker: Hugo Toras
461.text: "By continuing it, we risk backlash from Su Omina supporters and general discord between nationalists and the Rizian government."

464.speaker: Player_Romus
464.text: "I'm hesitant to pursue a deeper investigation into Pales because of the potential backlash, particularly if it were to surface publicly."

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "I'm not convinced. Shifting focus to Pales might complicate our diplomatic relationship."
465.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >=1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 1) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: "Yes. Refocusing our efforts toward Pales might very well be our best course of action."

468.speaker: Hugo Toras
468.text: "Internationally, this move could strain our relations with not only Pales but the region as a whole."

469.speaker: Hugo Toras
469.text: "I'm with you, Your Majesty. Such a shift in priorities might not only strain our relations with Pales but also with the entire region."

470.speaker: Hugo Toras
470.text: "I'm not convinced. Shifting priorities risks harming our relationship with Pales and escalating tensions regionally."

471.speaker: Lucita Azaro
471.text: "If we keep pursuing them in the absence of concrete leads, Smolak may use it as justification to hold on to Zille. Despite the agreement we signed."

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "What kind of repercussions could be anticipated if we direct our investigation toward Pales?"
472.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_Palesrepercussions"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_Palesrepercussions"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSOAndPales"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

473.speaker: Hugo Toras
473.text: "Internationally, if Pales got word of our investigation, it could strain our relations with not only the Grand Duchy but Lespia and eastern Merkopa as a whole."

474.speaker: Hugo Toras
474.text: "And on a positive note, taking the spotlight off of Su Omina would indebt the organization to us."

475.speaker: Lucita Azaro
475.text: "If on the Crown's side, an organization like that could have many uses, Your Majesty."

488.speaker: Titus Gordion
488.text: "On the other hand, bringing Su Omina to justice could garner support from nations that oppose nationalist movements, and be seen as a step toward curbing extremist ideologies."

489.speaker: Narrator
489.text: Lucita gave him a sharp look.

490.speaker: Titus Gordion
490.text: "And If we did find the organization guilty, confirming Wehlen's suspicions, we would no doubt have an edge in securing the return of Zille. Your Majesty."

494.speaker: Hugo Toras
494.text: "Unfortunately, it appears we don't have the budget to continue this investigation. In either of the directions mentioned."

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "Seems awfully convenient how funds run out when such issues don't align with your preferences."

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "Good. I was growing tired of this mess altogether."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "Well, if I'd known that from the beginning, I'd have ended this conversation much sooner."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "That's unfortunate. But if the treasury won't allow for it, then my hands are tied."

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "I understand your reluctance to investigate Su Omina, Uncle, but I think we must prioritize investigating them." [-1 Budget]

500.speaker: Lucita Azaro
500.text: "That's all well and good, but maybe it's time that the investigation falls under my jurisdiction."

501.speaker: Lucita Azaro
501.text: "I believe my department would be much more suitable than the Golden Guard."

502.speaker: Titus Gordion
502.text: "I assure you, Duchess, my men are up to the task."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "Considering that your international ground operations are far more extensive than the Golden Guards', I agree to transfer those responsibilities to you -- no offense, Titus."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "The Golden Guard has done a fine job with the investigation, so let's stay the course."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "It doesn't make sense this far into the investigation to transfer responsibilities to someone else."

506.speaker: Titus Gordion
506.text: "If that's what you desire, then so be it."

508.speaker: Lucita Azaro
508.text: "Very well. I was only offering an alternative solution."

509.speaker: Lucita Azaro
509.text: "Nevertheless, I look forward to hearing what you find on Pales."

510.speaker: Hugo Toras
510.text: "Pursuing this path won't lead us anywhere productive."

511.speaker: Narrator
511.text: Hugo's brows furrowed as he clenched his fists.

515.speaker: Hugo Toras
515.text: "Respectfully, I believe pursuing this path won't lead us anywhere productive."

519.speaker: Hugo Toras
519.text: "Need I remind you of their resistance operations within Zille? Ones in which they are currently engaged?"

520.speaker: Player_Romus
520.text: "Continuing the investigation into Su Omina could reinforce Wehlen's beliefs about their involvement, granting us leverage in future Zille negotiations."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "And need I remind you who you're speaking to? In any case, it won't be a problem so don't ask about it again."

522.speaker: Player_Romus
522.text: "Don't second guess my judgment. I know what I'm doing."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Further investigation of Su Omina may reinforce Wehlen's existing beliefs about their involvement, giving us leverage in future negotiations regarding Zille."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "It won't be a problem, so don't ask about it again."

529.speaker: Hugo Toras
529.text: "I also fear that it will prove counterproductive to their resistance operations within Zille."

530.speaker: Hugo Toras
530.text: "But I will speak of it no further. As always, your judgment prevails."

531.speaker: Narrator
531.text: Hugo released a sigh and his shoulders drooped, giving the impression of defeat.

532.speaker: Narrator
532.text: Hugo's shoulders drooped in a defeated posture.

533.speaker: Narrator
533.text: Hugo let out a sigh and shook his head in frustration.

536.speaker: Narrator
536.text: Hugo ran his hands through his hair in frustration.

537.speaker: Hugo Toras
537.text: "If you're dead-set on investigating Su Omina, then so be it."

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "So let's drop the matter altogether and move on to more pressing issues."

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "With that in mind, let's put an end to this inquiry altogether."

543.speaker: Player_Romus
543.text: "Therefore, we should entrust the Zille bombing matter to higher powers and shift the responsibility to others to deal with."

544.speaker: Hugo Toras
544.text: "Yes. That may very well be the most favorable path for everyone involved."

545.speaker: Hugo Toras
545.text: "When you put it that way, yes. I suppose that it may be in our best interest to drop it."

546.speaker: Hugo Toras
546.text: "Very well. In the end, this may very well be the best course of action."

547.speaker: Lucita Azaro
547.text: "I think your initial instinct to continue the investigation was the right decision, but if that's what you desire, then I won't object."

548.speaker: Lucita Azaro
548.text: "Not to mention, it lets outside parties control the narrative, which could work to our disadvantage."

549.speaker: Lucita Azaro
549.text: "But if that is what you desire, then I won't stand in opposition."

550.speaker: Lucita Azaro
550.text: "I disagree. I believe that continuing the investigation and discovering who is behind it works to our advantage."

551.speaker: Lucita Azaro
551.text: "I'm concerned our adversaries might perceive our inability to get to the bottom of this as a sign of weakness."

552.speaker: Player_Romus
552.text: "If we proceed and identify the perpetrators, be it Wehlen, Pales, or any other party, the political risks far outweigh the potential benefits."

554.speaker: Lucita Azaro
554.text: "I, for one, was eager to see this come to a logical conclusion."

555.speaker: Lucita Azaro
555.text: "I hope any repercussions won't pose future challenges for us."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "That's a relief. I was beginning to grow tired of this mess."

558.speaker: Player_Romus
558.text: "Now you're telling me? If I'd known that from the beginning, I'd have ended this conversation much sooner."

559.speaker: Lucita Azaro
559.text: "Well, I, for one, was eager to see this come to a logical conclusion."

560.speaker: Lucita Azaro
560.text: "I do hope that the consequences, whatever they may be, don't end up causing problems for us in the future."

564.speaker: Hugo Toras
564.text: "I hate to put a damper on things, but we actually lack the resources to continue this investigation. In either direction."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "That's disappointing. But if the treasury won't allow it then my hands are tied."

568.speaker: Lucita Azaro
568.text: "Yes. Our immigration officers have been instructed to turn away migrants attempting to enter Rizia from Derdia."

569.speaker: Lucita Azaro
569.text: "The border ban has had significant effects. And it's stirred up no small amount of controversy."

570.speaker: Titus Gordion
570.text: "My guards in Iza witnessed a demonstration against the ban held by the local Derdian population, with other Golcondists joining in solidarity."

571.speaker: Lucita Azaro
571.text: "The ban has also affected our economy. Many Derdians held crucial low-wage jobs. Now, labor shortages are becoming noticeable."

572.speaker: Lucita Azaro
572.text: "Some industries are struggling to find replacements."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "I was aware that these decisions would be difficult, but I didn't anticipate the extent."

574.speaker: Hugo Toras
574.text: "Fortunately, the international community has mostly ignored our ban. Few nations besides Derdia are willing to vouch for the Bluds."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "Ah, that's not a big concern. We'll figure it out."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "There's always someone out there looking for a job. Any labor shortages will be short-lived."

577.speaker: Player_Romus
577.text: "I agree, up to a point. If our security agreements conflict with the interests of our other neighbors, a reassessment might be in order."

578.speaker: Player_Romus
578.text: "That goes without saying. I only hope that in the end, the cost is worth it."

579.speaker: Player_Romus
579.text: "You're absolutely right, Uncle. If we're to bring Zille back into our fold, we must stay the course."

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.text: "Indeed, should the turmoil escalate, it might necessitate a reassessment of our approach."

581.speaker: Hugo Toras
581.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, our other neighbors are not occupying our land."

582.speaker: Lucita Azaro
582.text: "With the exception of the Palesians, if you ask my family."

583.speaker: Hugo Toras
583.text: "We should not let these developments derail us. Our top priority should be to maintain amicable relations with Wehlen if our ultimate goal is to regain Zille."

590.speaker: Lucita Azaro
590.text: "By pure chance, this morning, one of our patrol vessels intercepted an overcrowded Bludish migrant ship crossing the Gulf."

592.speaker: Lucita Azaro
592.text: "And they were lucky we did. Our investigative team determined that had they stayed out any longer, the ship would have been at risk of sinking."

593.speaker: Lucita Azaro
593.text: "The 500-plus asylum seekers are currently being processed at one of our migrant facilities."

594.speaker: Player_Romus
594.text: "It's heartbreaking to think of those who never make it to safety."

596.speaker: Player_Romus
596.text: "Thanks for the update. It's good that they were intercepted in time."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "When will they learn to follow the rules and avoid such risks?"

598.speaker: Lucita Azaro
598.text: "When they are not forced into such desperate circumstances, Your Majesty."

599.speaker: Hugo Toras
599.text: "Certainly, but it's important to consider long-term solutions to prevent such situations."

600.speaker: Lucita Azaro
600.text: "All the more reason to improve the situation for all migrants."

601.speaker: Hugo Toras
601.text: "Indeed. A burden on our already stretched resources."

604.speaker: Hugo Toras
604.text: "Absolutely. The effort and sacrifices will pay off in the end. I'm sure of it."

605.speaker: Lucita Azaro
605.text: "On the other hand, let us remember that there are circumstances where effort and sacrifices alone are insufficient."

606.speaker: Hugo Toras
606.text: "Excellent! Your dedication gives me full confidence in our success."

607.speaker: Lucita Azaro
607.text: "Yes, but let us also remember that there are circumstances where dedication alone is insufficient."

608.speaker: Hugo Toras
608.text: "You're absolutely right. Duchess Azaro, I hope you are monitoring the situation closely."

609.speaker: Lucita Azaro
609.text: "Is there any other kind of monitoring, Your Grace?"

613.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
613.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true) == false

614.speaker: Hugo Toras
614.text: "Your decision to elevate the status of the Wehzek population has certainly won the Crown supporters in Little Wraclawitz."
614.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == true) == false)

615.speaker: Titus Gordion
615.text: "For what it is worth, my sources corroborate the Duchess' claim."

616.speaker: Titus Gordion
616.text: "The police often tie their fight against the illicit drug trade as an excuse to arrest migrants."

617.speaker: Player_Romus
617.text: "While Rico has his faults, surely he wouldn't cross the line into authoritarianism."

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "I knew it was a mistake to put the Central Police under Rico's command."

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "Extreme circumstances call for extreme measures. He should be able to use the police as he wishes."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "Sounds like the situation is far more dire than what's being conveyed."

624.speaker: Hugo Toras
624.text: "The situation is serious, but not out of control."

625.speaker: Lucita Azaro
625.text: "Not if it leads to the public losing trust in law enforcement."

626.speaker: Hugo Toras
626.text: "Correct, Your Majesty. I am sure the Duchess is exaggerating."

628.speaker: Hugo Toras
628.text: "No, your Majesty, you made the right decision. Duchess Azaro is exaggerating."

630.speaker: Player_Romus
630.text: "The problem lies with the police in general, not with who's controlling them. I'm withdrawing the reinforcements."

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "Rico's control over the Central Police needs to end. Lucita, you will assume authority over them."

632.speaker: Hugo Toras
632.text: "My son is trying to maintain order in Iza. Stripping him of this power--"

633.speaker: Lucita Azaro
633.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I will ensure they serve the crown, not any faction."

635.speaker: Player_Romus
635.text: "We'll withdraw the Central Police from Iza and let the Brenas provincial police take over. They're less involved in local politics."

636.speaker: Hugo Toras
636.text: "So you are throwing Rico to the wolves."

637.speaker: Lucita Azaro
637.text: "They did offer to cooperate. Their presence could prove useful in calming down the locals."

638.speaker: Player_Romus
638.text: "I'm confident in the abilities of the Central Police and those of Rico. Let's stick with the status quo for now and see how things develop."

639.speaker: Hugo Toras
639.text: "I'm glad to hear it. Give Rico more time, and he will prove himself as a leader."

643.speaker: Hugo Toras
643.text: "With all due respect, I believe such a move to be premature. I request giving them additional time to carry out their objectives."

644.speaker: Lucita Azaro
644.text: "His Majesty has spoken, Your Grace. We should not question his decision."

645.speaker: Player_Romus
645.text: "I firmly believe no extra police presence is needed. I will look into other means of resolving the situation."

649.speaker: Player_Romus
649.text: "The Central Police are needed to quell the unrest but should operate independently from local authorities. Therefore, I will place them under Lucita's command."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "It's evident that the Central Police are needed to quell the unrest. So I will deploy them to Iza and place them under Rico's command to do with as he sees fit."

654.speaker: Player_Romus
654.text: "Your suggestion to deploy the Brenas police independently holds merit, especially in garnering favor with House Sazon."

655.speaker: Titus Gordion
655.text: "I think doing so will prove to be quite advantageous."

656.speaker: Hugo Toras
656.text: "But it will be perceived as a challenge to Rico's authority! Moreover, it will significantly impede his capacity to govern."

657.speaker: Lucita Azaro
657.text: "With all due respect, I believe that was His Majesty's intention."

659.speaker: Hugo Toras
659.text: "An excellent choice. I'm confident that Rico will make effective use of them to quickly bring the situation under control."

660.speaker: Lucita Azaro
660.text: "I still believe they should have external oversight. I sincerely hope that they won't be manipulated by local authorities."

662.speaker: Hugo Toras
662.text: "My son is trying to maintain order in Iza. Denying him this power--"

663.speaker: Lucita Azaro
663.text: "Thank you for your confidence, Your Majesty. Rest assured, their allegiance will be to the Crown, not any faction."

665.speaker: Narrator
665.text: And the more I thought it over, the more I realized how it might be my one shot at removing Rico and coming out of it relatively unscathed.

666.speaker: Player_Romus
666.text: "I've got a bombshell to drop about our Zille bombing investigation!"

667.speaker: Player_Romus
667.text: "I need to discuss something of great importance concerning the Zille bombing with you."

668.speaker: Player_Romus
668.text: "It's important to get to the bottom of who is responsible for the Zille bombing. That's why I'd like to discuss another related matter with you in private."

669.speaker: Titus Gordion
669.text: "Certainly. How can I be of service?"

671.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

672.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true) == false

682.speaker: Titus Gordion
682.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true)

686.speaker: Titus Gordion
686.text: "I thought it was decided to put an end to that investigation."
686.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true)

687.speaker: Titus Gordion
687.text: "Regardless, I'm more than willing to assist however I can."

688.speaker: Titus Gordion
688.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true)

689.speaker: Titus Gordion
689.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true)

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "To be perfectly blunt, I'm looking to establish a direct connection between the Duke of Iza and the incident."

691.speaker: Player_Romus
691.text: "We're going to hold my cousin Rico partially accountable for it."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: "I want the evidence to ultimately connect to the reigning Duke of Iza."

693.speaker: Player_Romus
693.text: "I want you to uncover fresh evidence that will secure a direct link between the bombing and my cousin Rico."

694.speaker: Narrator
694.text: Titus seemed momentarily taken aback, the surprise written across his face.

696.speaker: Narrator
696.text: Titus nodded his head as he seemed to process what I'd said. His eyes went wide when it hit him.

697.speaker: Narrator
697.text: Titus absorbed my words. A moment later, his eyes widened in understanding.

698.speaker: Titus Gordion
698.text: "I must admit, that was not what I was expecting to hear."

700.speaker: Titus Gordion
700.text: "I see. As in... disregard the evidence or should I say, refine it."

702.speaker: Player_Romus
702.text: "Of course, if you don't think you can handle it, I can always find someone else to assist me on this endeavor."

703.speaker: Player_Romus
703.text: "You have a problem with that, Captain?"

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "Aren't you going to ask me why?"

706.speaker: Titus Gordion
706.text: "That's not what I meant. I was just curious as to the parameters of such a request."

707.speaker: Titus Gordion
707.text: "Not at all. But even if I did, my job is to carry out any task asked of me by my king.... without question."

708.speaker: Titus Gordion
708.text: "I don't need a reason. I'm here to serve at the hand of the king."

710.speaker: Titus Gordion
710.text: "But just so we're absolutely clear, how exactly do I fit into all of this? What are the specifics?"

711.speaker: Titus Gordion
711.text: "On the contrary, I was curious as to where I fit into all of this."

712.speaker: Player_Romus
712.text: "Given the Golden Guard's history of clandestine operations, I'd like them to stumble across evidence implicating my cousin to the crime."

713.speaker: Player_Romus
713.text: "I'm glad you asked. You're to be tasked with ensuring cousin Rico has sufficient evidence linking him to the bombing."

714.speaker: Player_Romus
714.text: "I need you to plant evidence linking Rico to what happened in Zille. I don't care how you do it, just make it happen."

715.speaker: Narrator
715.text: Titus straightened his spine, assuming a more upright and attentive stance.

716.speaker: Narrator
716.text: He shifted his stance, bringing his shoulders back and his chest forward to stand at full attention.

717.speaker: Narrator
717.text: Titus squared his shoulders, fully at attention.

718.speaker: Titus Gordion
718.text: "If the king wishes for me to fabricate -- excuse me -- *uncover* undisclosed evidence, then say no more. It will take some time, but it would be my honor."

721.speaker: Player_Romus
721.text: "Excellent. We can discuss the details in the coming days."

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "I appreciate your enthusiasm, but keep in mind, this course of action is fraught with risks."

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "I must admit, I underestimated you, Captain Gordion. I look forward to what future partnerships might bring."

726.speaker: Titus Gordion
726.text: "I have no doubt it will be a fruitful cooperation."

727.speaker: Titus Gordion
727.text: "If I say I'll do something, you can rely on me to fulfill your directive."

728.speaker: Narrator
728.text: Titus bid me farewell before he took his leave.

729.speaker: Narrator
729.text: Soon after the door closed behind him.

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "ATA is also active in Zille. How are their activities going on in tandum with Su Omina's?"

734.speaker: Player_Romus
734.text: "How well are they coordinating with ATA's efforts in Zille?"

735.speaker: Player_Romus
735.text: "I'm curious whether these initiatives will produce a comparable impact to our more diplomatic approaches, such as ATA."

736.speaker: Lucita Azaro
736.text: "Not as well as we had hoped. Their conflicting resistance methods are causing a great deal of animosity between the two groups."

737.speaker: Lucita Azaro
737.text: "Both initiatives are producing positive results. However, their conflicting resistance methods are causing a great deal of animosity between them."

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "Why am I only hearing about this now?"

739.speaker: Lucita Azaro
739.text: "They've been promoting pro-Rizian sentiment, but it's causing a clash with Su Omina's approach."

741.speaker: Lucita Azaro
741.text: "ATA's cultural exchange programs and festivals, as noble as they are, are seen by Su Omina as a way to dilute their influence."

742.speaker: Lucita Azaro
742.text: "The more the people engage in these activities, the less they're inclined to support Su Omina's more extreme methods."

743.speaker: Player_Romus
743.text: "It's a battle for the hearts and minds of the people. I don't want these two groups working at cross-purposes."

744.speaker: Lucita Azaro
744.text: "I suggest facilitating a dialogue between ATA and Su Omina. Perhaps they could find common ground or areas where they can collaborate."

745.speaker: Lucita Azaro
745.text: "It's essential to ensure that their friction doesn't escalate the unrest further."

746.speaker: Hugo Toras
746.text: "I can't see Su Omina altering their tactics."

747.speaker: Hugo Toras
747.text: "They are keen on maintaining a firm image and avoiding any perception of weakness. And the ATA doesn't exactly project strength."

748.speaker: Player_Romus
748.text: "You're right, Lucita. We must bring them to the table and find a way for these two groups to work together."

749.speaker: Player_Romus
749.text: "Avoiding any appearance of vulnerability is toxic,  which is the last thing we need."

750.speaker: Player_Romus
750.text: "You're right, Hugo. Trying to get them to sit down together and break bread is a waste of time."

751.speaker: Lucita Azaro
751.text: "I'll start the negotiations immediately, Your Majesty. We need unity if we're to stabilize Zille."

752.speaker: Player_Romus
752.text: "We need to find a solution to this unnecessary mess."

753.speaker: Player_Romus
753.text: "I'm not worried about it. Squabbling will only encourage them to redouble their efforts and come up with innovative solutions."

754.speaker: Player_Romus
754.text: "I hate to say it, but encouraging resistance efforts from two contrasting angles might prove to be a mistake."

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "I'm sure it's just a misunderstanding that can be easily worked out."

758.speaker: Lucita Azaro
758.text: "I apologize, Your Majesty. But this assessment has only just arrived."

759.speaker: Lucita Azaro
759.text: "Or drive them further apart and disrupt each other's missions entirely."

760.speaker: Lucita Azaro
760.text: "I recommend opening a channel for dialogue between ATA and Su Omina. This could help them discover common ground or identify opportunities for collaboration."

761.speaker: Lucita Azaro
761.text: "I think facilitating a dialogue between ATA and Su Omina is a start, one where they could find common ground or areas where they can collaborate."

762.speaker: Lucita Azaro
762.text: "It's crucial to prevent their conflicts from exacerbating the ongoing disruptions."

763.speaker: Lucita Azaro
763.text: "I understand your concerns, but let's not give up on this approach just yet. It could offer us valuable insights and options we wouldn't have considered otherwise."

764.speaker: Lucita Azaro
764.text: "I suggest -- if I may -- facilitating a dialogue between ATA and Su Omina. Perhaps they can find common ground or areas where they can collaborate."

765.speaker: Lucita Azaro
765.text: "With your permission, I'll ensure that negotiations between Su Omina and ATA begin immediately."

768.speaker: Lucita Azaro
768.text: "If that's what you think, then I won't pursue it."

771.speaker: Lucita Azaro
771.text: "Nor did I. But the polarization in our society has been very noticeable."

772.speaker: Titus Gordion
772.text: "The backlash has been palpable, to say the least."

773.speaker: Hugo Toras
773.text: "An unfortunate reaction -- temporary, I might add."

774.speaker: Lucita Azaro
774.text: "I'm not sure it's that simple. The ban has deeply divided our society."

775.speaker: Hugo Toras
775.text: "It's the driving force behind why we signed the agreement with Wiktor Smolak in the first place."

776.speaker: Lucita Azaro
776.text: "I hope you're right. Furthermore, the ban has deeply divided our society even more than it already was."

780.speaker: Lucita Azaro
780.text: "Our own Derdian population has expressed outrage, and other Golcondists have been protesting in solidarity."

781.speaker: Hugo Toras
781.text: "Fortunately, the international community has yet to speak out against our ban. Few nations are willing to vouch for either Derdians or Bluds."

782.speaker: Lucita Azaro
782.text: "Although it shouldn't be surprising that Derdian Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal has condemned us to the depths of hell, or whatever the Golcondists call it."

789.speaker: Narrator
789.text: After saying their goodbyes, Hugo, Lucita, and Titus took their leave.

790.speaker: Narrator
790.text: As everyone said their goodbyes and started to leave, I found myself contemplating the direction I had taken with the Zille bombing investigation.
790.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn03_Security_TitusLeadsInvestigation"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"]  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateEndInvestigation"] == false)

791.speaker: Narrator
791.text: While I could have just let the investigation go on as planned, I also saw another opportunity that could come out of it.

792.speaker: Narrator
792.text: Connecting it to my cousin, Rico.

793.speaker: Narrator
793.text: Whether directly implicated or not, his involvement was irrelevant. My agreement with Smolak to depose him was already in place, and the events in Zille offered the ideal chance to act on it.

794.speaker: Narrator
794.text: I just needed to ensure hard evidence could be linked to him -- a covert task a certain Captain of the Golden Guard just so happened to be specialized in.

795.speaker: Narrator
795.text: The only question was whether or not I should.

796.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
796.text: Pursue linking Rico to the Zille bombing.

797.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
797.text: Don't link Rico to the bombing.

798.speaker: Narrator
798.text: The risks simply outweighed the potential benefits. I'd just have to find a way to oust him by other means.

799.speaker: Narrator
799.text: So I called after Titus and redirected him back to the council chamber just as he was stepping into the hallway.

801.speaker: Narrator
801.text: Nevertheless, the weight of the security briefing still lingered in the air as I stood alone in the room.

802.speaker: Lucita Azaro
802.text: "In Brenas, nonviolent protesters are demanding greater representation and autonomy."

803.speaker: Lucita Azaro
803.text: "They claim that their leaders in House Sazon have been shunted aside since the uprising."

804.speaker: Player_Romus
804.text: "House Sazon *caused* that uprising. They can't whine about unfair treatment."

805.speaker: Hugo Toras
805.text: "Well, if they try anything that flirts with insurrectionism, the end result will be the same as it was then."

806.speaker: Hugo Toras
806.text: "Just as what happened in 1926, any insurrectionist actions will meet the same fate."

807.speaker: Player_Romus
807.text: "If the Sazons can't get their house in order, there will be hell to pay."

811.speaker: Player_Romus
811.text: "It's understandable that they want their voices heard, as autonomy is an important aspect of any thriving region."

813.speaker: Player_Romus
813.text: "These radicals are a mere annoyance. Why haven't they been taken care of yet?"

814.speaker: Lucita Azaro
814.text: "Believe me, they're more than just annoyances; they demand serious attention."

815.speaker: Hugo Toras
815.text: "Would you care to comment on the stirrings of dissent in Cardesse-Montaklar, Duchess Azaro?"

819.speaker: Hugo Toras
819.text: "Agreed. Because if they don't, it could have far-reaching consequences not just for them, but for the entire region."

820.speaker: Hugo Toras
820.text: "Not when it's at the expense of the crown."

822.speaker: Player_Romus
822.text: "Good. That's what I want to hear."

823.speaker: Player_Romus
823.text: "Repression alone might not be the solution, instead, our focus should be on restoring unity and understanding."

824.speaker: Player_Romus
824.text: "A strong response is essential in these times, for the Crown's authority must be upheld."

825.speaker: Lucita Azaro
825.text: "Forgive me, but from my experience, the only language these people understand is force."

826.speaker: Hugo Toras
826.text: "I'm with Lucita. We must maintain order at all costs."

827.speaker: Hugo Toras
827.text: "In Brenas, we've witnessed substantial rallies in the capital."

828.speaker: Lucita Azaro
828.text: "As for Cardesse-Montaklar, there have been instances of civil disobedience."

829.speaker: Hugo Toras
829.text: "In Valenqiris, protests are much more scattered, occurring in various regions."
829.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3)

830.speaker: Hugo Toras
830.text: "They've resorted to blocking key government facilities, both urban and rural, to make their concerns heard."

831.speaker: Lucita Azaro
831.text: "Your Majesty, this situation is complex; it requires a comprehensive approach to reconcile varying demands and concerns."

832.speaker: Player_Romus
832.text: "If escalation occurs, we'll require a strategic approach, open to dialogue and compromise."

833.speaker: Player_Romus
833.text: "Rushing into action might do more harm than good. Nevertheless, let's continue monitoring the situation."

834.speaker: Player_Romus
834.text: "Arresting protest leaders would send a clear message that the Crown is committed to maintaining order."

844.speaker: Player_Romus
844.text: "Let's discuss threats from within the populace. I've read some worrying reports."

845.speaker: Player_Romus
845.text: "If both of you agree it's serious, then it must be. Go on."

854.speaker: Lucita Azaro
854.text: "As for your very own Valenqiris, recent sentiments against the Royal Family have come as a surprise."

855.speaker: Lucita Azaro
855.text: "A growing number of Toras nobles have complained that their needs are not being addressed."

856.speaker: Player_Romus
856.text: "Treacherous bastards. After everything we've done for them."

857.speaker: Hugo Toras
857.text: "Overall, it's a multifaceted issue. Autonomy, political power, and economic equity are all intertwined in these problems. Specifically..."

858.speaker: Hugo Toras
858.text: "The public feels that the royal traditions they have long held sacred are being ignored -- or even spat on."
858.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

862.speaker: Hugo Toras
862.text: "The human rights situation in Rizia is apparently concerning to some."
862.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

866.speaker: Player_Romus
866.text: "These protesters are taking for granted the stability and security we provide."
866.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

867.speaker: Hugo Toras
867.text: "It's a shame that they don't appreciate the peace and prosperity we've built for our people."

868.speaker: Player_Romus
868.text: "We need to do a better job of addressing their concerns."
