870.speaker: Player_Romus
870.text: "But we *have* been working on these issues. Progress has been made."
870.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

872.speaker: Hugo Toras
872.text: "Unfortunately, that's not how the crown's policies are being perceived."

876.speaker: Player_Romus
876.text: "It pains me to hear such animosity. I do hope we can find a way to rectify the situation."

877.speaker: Player_Romus
877.text: "Hugo, can you tell me anything more about this?"

878.speaker: Hugo Toras
878.text: "I spend little time in Valenqiris, Your Majesty. But I will look into these complaints more closely."

879.speaker: Hugo Toras
879.text: "I will see what I can do."

880.speaker: Hugo Toras
880.text: "I can think of a few more colorful words to call them, but 'treacherous' will suffice for now."

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "I'm surprised you never pursued a career in theatre, given your proclivity for over-dramatizing everything."
886.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

890.speaker: Hugo Toras
890.text: "I am most certainly *not* being dramatic. The seriousness of this situation can't be understated."

892.speaker: Hugo Toras
892.text: "Even if we weren't limited by financial constraints, throwing money around doesn't guarantee a favorable outcome."

893.speaker: Lucita Azaro
893.text: "I'm with Hugo. That kind of talk is a direct threat to the aristocracy."

896.speaker: Lucita Azaro
896.text: "My thoughts exactly. It will help us ensure order."

898.speaker: Lucita Azaro
898.text: "Qualities this kingdom has upheld for hundreds of years."

902.speaker: Narrator
902.text: Hugo and Lucita rose to their feet the moment I stepped into the council chambers.

918.speaker: Lucita Azaro
918.text: "The Central Police should be tackling the illegal drug trade, not using it as a pretext to arrest migrants."

925.speaker: Player_Romus
925.text: "During these intricate challenges, let's seek divine guidance for a harmonious path to help us reconcile such diverse demands."

930.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
930.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_Scapegoats"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true)

931.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
931.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_Scapegoats"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true)) == false

935.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
935.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSuOmina"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_Security_InvestigateBombingWehlen"] == true) == false

940.speaker: Titus Gordion
940.text: "Yes, there's plenty of religious groups from which to choose."

945.speaker: Narrator
945.text: If Titus did notice, he either didn't display any reaction or remained indifferent.

949.speaker: Narrator
949.text: My remark elicited hearty laughter from Hugo, while Lucita responded with a more reserved chuckle. Titus, on the other hand, didn't so much as flinch.

956.speaker: Narrator
956.text: Hugo and Lucita took their respective seats. Aides placed folders full of information in front of each of us, and glasses of water were poured.

957.speaker: Narrator
957.text: I quickly scanned the contents laid out before me.

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "These insubordinate protesters forget the stability and security I graciously allow them to enjoy."
961.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

962.speaker: Player_Romus
962.text: "If we don't address these issues soon, the discontent could become a permanent fixture of the political landscape."

972.speaker: Player_Romus
972.text: "Although this situation is as brain-numbingly complex as deciphering Morse code, we will strive to untangle it, and consider changing state policy."

976.speaker: Player_Romus
976.text: "Reconciling the diverse demands and concerns that beset our kingdom might be in order."

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "You will end your investigation, Duchess Azaro. End of discussion."

986.speaker: Player_Romus
986.text: "So let's put the Zille bombing issue behind us, and let someone else deal with it."

990.speaker: Player_Romus
990.text: "We should always expect the unexpected, dear Titus, even when we think we know what to expect."

994.speaker: Narrator
994.text: A look of momentary confusion crossed Titus' face.

995.speaker: Titus Gordion
995.text: "As I was saying... One of the Su Omina members my team was surveilling is employed at a fertilizer plant just outside of Iza. TerraGrowth Agrochem."

996.speaker: Player_Romus
996.text: "Am I really supposed to trust the word of a glorified bodyguard over that of my security councilor?"

1005.speaker: Player_Romus
1005.text: "Discontent presents an opportunity for transformation. This moment allows us to comprehend the concerns of our people."

1009.speaker: Hugo Toras
1009.text: "Understanding them is one thing, resolving their grievances is another."

1010.speaker: Player_Romus
1010.text: "Let them grumble. We have a kingdom to run, and these protests are insignificant in the grand scheme of things."

1011.speaker: Hugo Toras
1011.text: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, dismissing discontent as 'quaint' may underestimate its potential impact on the stability and unity of our kingdom."

1019.speaker: Player_Romus
1019.text: "Relax, Uncle. I was just trying to get all the facts. Even if Rico were connected, for all we know, he might be a secret gardener at heart."

1020.speaker: Narrator
1020.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I could see Lucita holding back a smile.

1021.speaker: Hugo Toras
1021.text: "A secret gardener? Really? This is preposterous."

1022.speaker: Hugo Toras
1022.text: "The local migrant population continues to complain of unfair treatment."
1022.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true) == false

1026.speaker: Hugo Toras
1026.text: "You've done much to win the support of the Wehzek and Derdian population."
1026.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_LaborHandsLegalized"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == true)

1027.speaker: Hugo Toras
1027.text: "Unfortunately, that has done little to curb tensions. In fact, it's emboldened migrants to openly defy the police."

1031.speaker: Hugo Toras
1031.text: "Nevertheless, I'm confident that with the reinforcements you provided, Rico will be able to restore order."

1032.speaker: Hugo Toras
1032.text: "Which has led to further pushback against the city's police forces."

1033.speaker: Hugo Toras
1033.text: "My son has been overwhelmed trying to restore order. His men are stretched to their limit."

1035.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1035.text: "I beg to differ, Your Grace. Duke Ricardus' use of the Central Police is part of the problem."

1036.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1036.text: "But only if they serve with impartiality, which is decidedly not the case here."

1040.speaker: Narrator
1040.text: Lucita straightened in her seat, seemingly eager to intervene.

1041.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1041.text: "Unfortunately, Your Grace, I believe your son is part of the problem."

1043.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1043.text: "It's no wonder there are still revolts."

1050.speaker: Titus Gordion
1050.text: "Controlled substances may be legal in Rizia now, but the Central Police are still using the drug trade as a pretext to arrest migrants."

1051.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1051.text: "I'm still convinced that the Central Police, as deployed by Duke Ricardus, are not the right solution."

1052.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1052.text: "For better or worse, drugs remain legal in Rizia -- yet the Central Police is still using the drug trade as a pretext to arrest migrants."

1056.speaker: Hugo Toras
1056.text: "Or that those perpetuating it are mostly of foreign origin?"

1057.speaker: Hugo Toras
1057.text: "Or that many of those perpetuating it have indeed been migrants?"

1058.speaker: Hugo Toras
1058.text: "Or that those using it to sell drugs are mostly of foreign origin?"

1059.speaker: Player_Romus
1059.text: "You're right, Uncle. We can't pretend that nationality is not a factor in crime."

1062.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1062.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) == false

1063.speaker: Player_Romus
1063.text: "Once the prices of legal drugs come down, this won't be a problem. We just need more time."

1064.speaker: Player_Romus
1064.text: "Society pushed them into the drug trade. It wasn't like they chose to become criminals."
1064.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] < 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) == false

1065.speaker: Player_Romus
1065.text: "Maybe so, but harsh policing will not solve anything."

1066.speaker: Player_Romus
1066.text: "Any success we've had in combatting the drug trade has been in spite of harsher policing, not because of it."

1067.speaker: Player_Romus
1067.text: "Yes, I have faith that the Central Police are performing their job correctly."

1068.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1068.text: "The provincial police in Brenas have offered their cooperation if the Central Police is removed."

1069.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1069.text: "I stand by my assessment that unless some change is made, order in Iza will not improve on its own."

1073.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1073.text: "Since His Majesty abolished the provincial police, we are unable to ask for help from Brenas."

1074.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1074.text: "But in any event, I think the obvious solution is a simple change in oversight of the Central Police."

1075.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1075.text: "However, given their soft stance on foreigner-committed crimes in Sallabes and Jales, we can't count on them enforcing our policies."

1079.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1079.text: "Although I am concerned they'll let legitimate crimes committed by migrants slip through the cracks."

1080.speaker: Player_Romus
1080.text: "They'll try to overthrow Rico if given half a chance. We shouldn't rely on them."

1081.speaker: Player_Romus
1081.text: "Rico's hard-line stance isn't working. Perhaps a softer approach is called for."

1082.speaker: Player_Romus
1082.text: "It seems to me that a situation of this magnitude calls for intervention from the Crown."

1083.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1083.text: "In my opinion, the most obvious solution is a change in oversight of the Central Police."

1084.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1084.text: "I would suggest something in between, such as a change in oversight of the Central Police."

1085.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1085.text: "Exactly. In my opinion, the most obvious solution is a simple change in oversight of the Central Police."

1086.speaker: Narrator
1086.text: Hugo fixed her with a stare.

1087.speaker: Hugo Toras
1087.text: "You'd like His Majesty to place the reinforcements under your command, I suppose."

1088.speaker: Player_Romus
1088.text: "I'm not convinced police are the solution to anything. From Brenas or otherwise."

1089.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1089.text: "Perhaps not. Still, if the Central Police are to remain in Iza, I believe a change in their oversight is needed."

1090.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1090.text: "Well... yes. Allowing my department to take over law enforcement will leave the Duke free to focus on his other governing duties."

1091.speaker: Player_Romus
1091.text: "How effectively can he govern after we've publicly stripped him of authority?"

1092.speaker: Player_Romus
1092.text: "I like that idea. Perhaps it's time a grown-up took the reins over there."

1093.speaker: Player_Romus
1093.text: "What makes you think you will succeed where he failed?"

1094.speaker: Player_Romus
1094.text: "Don't get greedy, Duchess. I've already given you a lot."

1098.speaker: Hugo Toras
1098.text: "Yes, precisely. If the Crown does not place confidence in Rico's leadership abilities, neither will his subjects."

1099.speaker: Hugo Toras
1099.text: "It is that attitude that is impeding my son's ability to reign. We must place more trust in his abilities."

1100.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1100.text: "Your Majesty, look at my track record as Duchess of Montaklar. I know a thing or two about restoring order."

1101.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1101.text: "Because you knew I was the best person for the job. As is the case here."

1102.speaker: Hugo Toras
1102.text: "I have no doubt in your ability to handle the situation, Duchess Azaro. But my son must be given a chance."

1103.speaker: Hugo Toras
1103.text: "If his subjects regard him as powerless, all will be lost."

1107.speaker: Narrator
1107.text: Both Hugo and Lucita looked troubled.

1111.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1111.text: "While Captain Gordion's investigation has hampered Su Omina activities, Duke Ricardus has basically been using the municipal police as a replacement."

1112.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1112.text: "With the Duke's public support of Su Omina, the group has become ever bolder."

1113.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1113.text: "Don't get me wrong. I believe the police are invaluable to keeping the peace in a city like Iza."

1114.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1114.text: "The provincial police in Brenas have offered their cooperation."

1115.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1115.text: "However, given their soft stance on foreigner-committed crimes in Sallabes and Jales, we can't count on them enforcing our policies."

1119.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1119.text: "Their attitude towards foreigners is certainly in line with the Crown's. Although I am concerned they'll let legitimate crimes committed by migrants slip through the cracks."

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "They'll try to overthrow Rico if given half a chance. We shouldn't rely on them."

1121.speaker: Player_Romus
1121.text: "Rico's hard-line stance isn't working. Perhaps a softer approach is called for."

1122.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1122.text: "Yes. granting too much authority to Brenas is always a mistake."

1123.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1123.text: "I wouldn't risk it. Not with Iza's current lack of order."

1127.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1127.text: "Since His Majesty abolished the provincial police, we are unable to ask for help from Brenas."

1128.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1128.text: "In any case, I doubt they would have been all that useful. They've always been too lenient on crime."

1129.speaker: Player_Romus
1129.text: "It seems that a situation of this magnitude calls for intervention from the Crown."

1130.speaker: Player_Romus
1130.text: "Rico's hard-line stance isn't working. Perhaps Iza could benefit from a softer approach."

1131.speaker: Player_Romus
1131.text: "I'm not convinced police are the solution to anything. From Brenas or otherwise."

1133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1133.text: "What Iza needs is a police force with efficiency and accountability."

1134.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1134.text: "I believe we should honor the Duke's request for reinforcements from the Central Police, without placing them under his direct jurisdiction."

1135.speaker: Narrator
1135.text: Hugo fixed her with a stare.

1136.speaker: Hugo Toras
1136.text: "And whose jurisdiction should they be under? Yours, I suppose?"

1137.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1137.text: "Well... yes. Allowing my department to take over law enforcement will leave the Duke free to focus on his other governing duties."

1138.speaker: Player_Romus
1138.text: "How effectively can he govern after we've undermined his authority?"

1139.speaker: Player_Romus
1139.text: "I like that idea. Perhaps it's time a grown-up took the reins over there."

1140.speaker: Player_Romus
1140.text: "What makes you think you will succeed where he failed?"

1141.speaker: Player_Romus
1141.text: "Don't get greedy, Duchess. I've already given you a lot."

1145.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1145.text: "Because you knew I was the best person for the job. As is the case here."

1146.speaker: Hugo Toras
1146.text: "Yes, precisely. If the Crown does not place confidence in Rico's leadership abilities, neither will his subjects."

1147.speaker: Hugo Toras
1147.text: "It is that attitude that is impeding my son's ability to reign. We must place more trust in his abilities."

1148.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1148.text: "Your Majesty, look at my track record as Duchess of Montaklar. I know a thing or two about restoring order."

1149.speaker: Narrator
1149.text: Both Hugo and Lucita looked troubled.

1150.speaker: Hugo Toras
1150.text: "I believe it's too late for such an approach. Without extra law enforcement, the city will fall."

1151.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1151.text: "His Majesty has spoken, Your Grace. We should not question his decision."

1153.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1153.text: "There is still the question of how we deal with Su Omina."

1155.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1155.text: "If my forces are to be consistent with the Crown's official stance on the group, we should make an effort to suppress its activities."

1159.speaker: Hugo Toras
1159.text: "I strongly disagree. Su Omina has done nothing wrong, and targeting the group would be yet another swipe at my son's authority."

1163.speaker: Hugo Toras
1163.text: "Not to mention, it would risk undermining their resistance efforts in Zille."

1164.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1164.text: "I do believe the group contributes to tension in Iza. However, if properly channeled, it could be turned to our advantage."

1165.speaker: Hugo Toras
1165.text: "True. Supporting Su Omina's activities would take pressure off law enforcement, and give us more... *flexibility* in dealing with unrest."

1169.speaker: Hugo Toras
1169.text: "Not to mention, it would increase morale among our resistance groups in Zille."

1170.speaker: Player_Romus
1170.text: "Su Omina is a menace to Iza. Duchess Azaro, I order your forces to crack down on the group."

1171.speaker: Player_Romus
1171.text: "I agree with Hugo. We should use Su Omina's Iza chapter to our benefit."

1172.speaker: Player_Romus
1172.text: "Good thinking, both of you. Duchess Azaro, you may engage with Iza's Su Omina chapter in any way you deem necessary."

1173.speaker: Player_Romus
1173.text: "I'd prefer to take a neutral stance. We will tolerate Su Omina's activities in Iza, but not encourage them."

1175.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1175.text: "Very well. That's perhaps the safest way to go."

1176.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1176.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I have no doubt we'll be able to get the city into shape."

1177.speaker: Narrator
1177.text: Lucita nodded while Hugo's expression soured.

1178.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1178.text: "I don't know whether they'll play along, given the Crown's history with them. But I'll do my best."

1179.speaker: Hugo Toras
1179.text: "I hope so. I'll tell Rico to give your forces his full cooperation."

1180.speaker: Hugo Toras
1180.text: "I'll tell Rico to give your forces his full cooperation."

1181.speaker: Hugo Toras
1181.text: "If you believe this is what must be done, I will not argue."

1187.speaker: Player_Romus
1187.text: "The universe certainly has a habit of throwing unexpected twists our way."

1190.speaker: Player_Romus
1190.text: "I will use the proceeds as I see fit."

1191.speaker: Player_Romus
1191.text: "In certain situations, he should have the flexibility to utilize the police as needed."

1192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1192.text: "Not if it results in eroding public confidence in law enforcement."

1193.speaker: Player_Romus
1193.text: "If the Sazons are unable to address their internal issues, they may be in need for a *friendly* chat."

1194.speaker: Hugo Toras
1194.text: "Absolutely. Failing to address these issues could have widespread implications, impacting not only them but the entire region."

1195.speaker: Player_Romus
1195.text: "Honestly, Hugo. You really are blowing things out of proportion."

1196.speaker: Hugo Toras
1196.text: "I am most certainly not. The seriousness of this situation can't be understated."

1197.speaker: Player_Romus
1197.text: "Although this situation remains complex, we will work to find a solution, even if it means making adjustments to state policy."

1201.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1201.text: "Having covered that, I believe I've touched upon all the key aspects of this issue."

1202.speaker: Player_Romus
1202.text: "Maybe we ought to explore alternative solutions that don't rely on law enforcement or security measures."

1208.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1208.text: "Such a route could very well have a positive impact on the situation."

1209.speaker: Hugo Toras
1209.text: "On the other hand, Your Majesty, such efforts may not be well-received by the native Rizians of Iza."

1210.speaker: Player_Romus
1210.text: "The name of the game here is compromise. We don't want to do anything that will rock the boat too drastically."

1211.speaker: Player_Romus
1211.text: "It's not a 'reward', Your Grace. It's putting migrants on equal footing with the rest of society."

1212.speaker: Player_Romus
1212.text: "Your intolerance will not be tolerated, Hugo. Duchess Azaro has the right idea."

1213.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1213.text: "Reducing the financial burden placed on migrants could decrease underground illicit activities."

1215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1215.text: "That's one possibility. Such a route could very well have a positive impact on the situation."

1216.speaker: Hugo Toras
1216.text: "It would if our budget had the funds to support such an endeavor."

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "What sort of programs were you thinking?"

1222.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1222.text: "Providing food assistance and meal programs for migrants who may face economic challenges for one."

1223.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1223.text: "Assisting them in finding and retaining employment, including resume building and interview training, is another."

1224.speaker: Titus Gordion
1224.text: "Language courses and cultural integration programs might also be beneficial."

1225.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1225.text: "And language courses and cultural integration programs could also be beneficial."

1231.speaker: Player_Romus
1231.text: "Focusing on internal welfare has historically quelled unrest. Can't we prioritize aid for the most vulnerable Iza residents?"

1232.speaker: Player_Romus
1232.text: "By bolstering social programs to assist those facing hardship."

1233.speaker: Player_Romus
1233.text: "Actually, disregard what I just said. I spoke hastily without considering any specific ideas."

1238.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1238.text: "That's one option to consider. Pursuing that path might indeed yield positive outcomes for the situation."

1239.speaker: Player_Romus
1239.text: "When you put it like that, it does sound like there are better ways to handle the situation."

1240.speaker: Hugo Toras
1240.text: "Yes, well, I hope the rest of society will see it that way."

1242.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1242.text: "No, of course not. We should focus on incremental changes."

1247.speaker: Hugo Toras
1247.text: "Their slogans and banners emphasize their desire for self-governance."

1248.speaker: Hugo Toras
1248.text: "The protesters are calling for a new constitutional agreement that decentralizes power."

1249.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1249.text: "They've organized sit-ins, demanding economic reforms to address the wealth gap."

1250.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1250.text: "I'm still gathering information on the ground. I don't have specific examples at this time."
1250.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras"] <= -3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] <= -3) == false)

1251.speaker: Hugo Toras
1251.text: "Our primary concern should be Wehlen's de-occupation of Zille. And the fastest way to achieve that is by confirming Wehzek involvement in the bombing."

1252.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1252.text: "The evidence we've gathered so far points strongly toward likely suspects."

1256.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1256.text: "The situation for Bluds in Wehlen must be truly dire if that's their only other recourse."

1257.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1257.text: "On a similar note, we need to talk about our agreement to turn away Derdians at the border."

1258.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1258.text: "While many nationalists endorse stricter immigration controls, others have become increasingly outraged."

1259.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1259.text: "While nationalists applaud tighter immigration controls, others have grown frustrated."

1260.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1260.text: "While nationalists appreciate stricter immigration controls, others have become more and more discontented."

1261.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1261.text: "However, I've received assurances that arrangements can be implemented without compromising the blockade's efficiency."

1262.speaker: Player_Romus
1262.text: "Better within their own borders than ours."

1263.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1263.text: "With Su Omina incapacitated by Captain Gordion's investigation, the Duke is basically using the Central Police as a replacement."

1264.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1264.text: "The Duke has basically been using the Central Police as an extension of Su Omina."

1265.speaker: Hugo Toras
1265.text: "Can we deny that the drug trade is a real problem in Rizia?"

1266.speaker: Hugo Toras
1266.text: "Can we deny that their efforts in curbing the drug trade have been successful?"

1267.speaker: Hugo Toras
1267.text: "Can we deny that a black market still exists?"

1268.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1268.text: "Their attitude towards foreigners is certainly in line with the Crown's."

1269.speaker: Hugo Toras
1269.text: "Why should their tax money be used to reward foreigners for causing trouble?"

1273.speaker: Narrator
1273.text: Hugo and Titus said their farewells before exiting the room.
1273.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_PromisedDate"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn03_Security_TitusLeadsInvestigation"] == false) == false)

1274.speaker: Player_Romus
1274.text: "We will put a stop to this investigation. I believe it will be more advantageous for us in the long run."

1275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1275.text: "Good evening, Your Majesty. I hope you're not too tired from your trip."

1276.speaker: Player_Romus
1276.text: "Nonsense. Nothing is more pressing than Rizia's security."

1282.speaker: Player_Romus
1282.text: "I assume you have news for me?"

1287.speaker: Titus Gordion
1287.text: "Big news, as a matter of fact."

1291.speaker: Hugo Toras
1291.text: "Your Majesty, the main reason we called you here is that there's been a breakthrough in the Friendship Day bombing investigation."

1294.speaker: Narrator
1294.text: I detected reluctance in his eyes as he signaled for Titus to proceed.

1295.speaker: Narrator
1295.text: He gestured for Lucita to proceed. She beamed with pride.

1296.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1296.text: "We found a number of capacitors and resistors, which are crucial for creating precise and dependable triggering mechanisms."

1300.speaker: Player_Romus
1300.text: "Reinhart thought I'd be more accommodating to Pales than my father. When that wasn't the case, he launched a campaign to destroy Rizia from within."

1304.speaker: Hugo Toras
1304.text: "He would have been taking quite the risk in doing so."

1305.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1305.text: "To me, that's the most likely possibility. The attack coming in the middle of the preliminary explorations for the Aureus gas field was no coincidence."

1306.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1306.text: "Sowing discord between Rizia and Wehlen might have been a way to create enough destabilization that we'd be entering negotiations from a place of vulnerability."

1307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1307.text: "Reinhart is the risk-taking type. We saw that with his aggressive pursuit of the Aureus gas field."

1308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1308.text: "And in fact, I doubt it was a coincidence that the bombing occurred in the middle of the gas field explorations."

1309.speaker: Player_Romus
1309.text: "It didn't work. We refused to cede the gas field without a fight."

1316.speaker: Player_Romus
1316.text: "It didn't work. We got access to the gas."

1318.speaker: Player_Romus
1318.text: "It worked. He made us pay through the nose for our own gas."

1319.speaker: Hugo Toras
1319.text: "On the other hand, we're on the brink of improving relations with Pales thanks to that deal."

1320.speaker: Hugo Toras
1320.text: "Painting Reinhart as a provocateur, especially with insignificant evidence, could sabotage our chances of reconciliation."

1324.speaker: Player_Romus
1324.text: "The joke's on him. I couldn't care less about that gas."
1324.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true)

1325.speaker: Player_Romus
1325.text: "It worked. We let go of our claim to Aureus at the drop of a hat."
1325.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true)

1326.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1326.text: "Reinhart couldn't have known that at the time."

1327.speaker: Hugo Toras
1327.text: "On the other hand, we're on the brink of improving relations with Pales thanks to that deal."

1328.speaker: Player_Romus
1328.text: "This is all just speculation. I want hard facts."

1330.speaker: Player_Romus
1330.text: "Okay, a motive has been established. But that's still not enough to convict Pales in any international court."

1331.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1331.text: "Yes. As I said, we need to dig deeper."

1333.speaker: Hugo Toras
1333.text: "Now that that's settled, I believe there are a number of other, less urgent security issues up for discussion."

1334.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1334.text: "There are indeed. Where would you like to start, Your Majesty?"

1336.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1336.text: "Does it, Captain Gordion? You have no evidence that the suspect in question was responsible for smuggling those materials out of the plant."

1337.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1337.text: "Do they, Captain Gordion? There is no evidence that the suspect in question was responsible for smuggling those materials out of the plant."

1338.speaker: Hugo Toras
1338.text: "What I mean is that my son is not a terrorist. You are better off exploring other avenues of investigation, Captain Gordion."

1339.speaker: Narrator
1339.text: Lucita leafed through the folder in front of her.

1340.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1340.text: "His Grace is correct, in a manner of speaking. There is one aspect of this evidence that invites much closer scrutiny."

1341.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1341.text: "However, you're correct that Ricardus should not be the main focus of this investigation. There is one aspect of Captain Gordion's evidence that invites much closer scrutiny."

1342.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1342.text: "There is one crucial piece of this puzzle that you have not yet mentioned, Captain Gordion."

1343.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1343.text: "And there is one crucial piece of this puzzle that you have not yet mentioned."

1344.speaker: Narrator
1344.text: Titus smiled thinly, his irritation evident.

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "Yes, the case against Su Omina appears much more clear-cut to me."

1350.speaker: Hugo Toras
1350.text: "I respectfully disagree. If there's even the slightest possibility Pales may have engineered this, we need to get to the bottom of it."

1356.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1356.text: "Wait, Your Majesty. I could easily assign this investigation to our intelligence unit in Pales without spending an extra cent."

1358.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1358.text: "Of course, it would mean that the case would once again fall under the jurisdiction of Rizia's security department, not your... extralegal operatives."

1359.speaker: Hugo Toras
1359.text: "A wise and frugal suggestion, Duchess Azaro."

1360.speaker: Hugo Toras
1360.text: "And in order to make the best use of those resources, we should choose our focus."

1361.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1361.text: "I had no idea you were so invested in Rizia's international reputation, Captain."

1363.speaker: Hugo Toras
1363.text: "However, I'm sure our fine investigative units would take care to prevent that from happening."

1367.speaker: Hugo Toras
1367.text: "But on a positive note, taking the spotlight off of Su Omina would indebt the organization to us."

1368.speaker: Hugo Toras
1368.text: "I'm convinced that with my son on their side, the organization could be a useful ally."

1375.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1375.text: "What's more... I could easily delegate this task to the intelligence forces we've already stationed there, and we wouldn't have to spend an extra cent."

1376.speaker: Hugo Toras
1376.text: "On a positive note, taking the spotlight off of Su Omina will indebt the organization to us."

1377.speaker: Hugo Toras
1377.text: "I'm convinced that with my son on their side, they could be a useful ally."

1378.speaker: Titus Gordion
1378.text: "My preliminary investigation results have given me no reason to trust this organization. But it's your call, Your Majesty.

1379.speaker: Player_Romus
1379.text: "I've made up my mind. Here's what we're going to do."
1379.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_Palesrepercussions"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn05_Security_InvestigateSOAndPales"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

1380.speaker: Narrator
1380.text: Hugo, Lucita and Titus all looked at me in anticipation of my decision.

1387.speaker: Player_Romus
1387.text: "By order of the King, Captain Gordion shall continue his investigation with a focus on Su Omina." [-1 Authority]

1388.speaker: Player_Romus
1388.text: "With the authority of the Crown, I hereby dispatch the expanded Golden Guard to Pales to investigate the Grand Duchy's role in the bombing." [-1 Authority]

1389.speaker: Player_Romus
1389.text: "I agree with Duchess Azaro. The Golden Guard will receive further funding to continue their investigation in Pales." [-1 Budget]

1393.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1393.text: "End it? But the evidence we've gathered  points strongly toward likely suspects."

1394.speaker: Hugo Toras
1394.text: "I agree. Ending the investigation at this point might send a message of impunity, not only within our borders but also to our neighboring nations."

1397.speaker: Player_Romus
1397.text: "You worry too much. We're fully capable of brushing off any potential blowback."

1398.speaker: Hugo Toras
1398.text: "If we halt the investigation abruptly, it might seem to others that we are unwilling to pursue justice for a crime committed on another sovereign state."

1399.speaker: Titus Gordion
1399.text: "And let's not forget Wehlen in all of this."

1400.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1400.text: "Exactly. Ending the investigation now may raise doubts about our commitment or even cast suspicion on our involvement."

1404.speaker: Player_Romus
1404.text: "Duchess Azaro, I want your Pales operatives on the case. This falls under your jurisdiction now."

1407.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1407.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. Captain Gordion, I expect all the relevant documents on my desk by tomorrow morning."

1412.speaker: Player_Romus
1412.text: "If it turns out Duke Reinhart was behind this, the Grand Duchy will pay dearly."
1412.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >=1  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Security_Pales_SendSpecialOps"] == true) == false)

1413.speaker: Hugo Toras
1413.text: "However, if Pales is innocent, the investigation in combination with our naval blockade will paint us as an unfair aggressor."

1417.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1417.text: "Wait, Your Majesty. I could easily assign this investigation to our intelligence unit in Pales without spending an extra cent."

1418.speaker: Hugo Toras
1418.text: "That's very frugal of you, Duchess Azaro."

1419.speaker: Narrator
1419.text: He looked at her, then at me.

1420.speaker: Hugo Toras
1420.text: "Our primary concern should be Wehlen's de-occupation of Zille. And the fastest way to achieve that is by confirming Wehzek involvement in the bombing."

1421.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1421.text: "On the other hand, Your Grace, what if it turns out Wehlen is innocent?"

1425.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1425.text: "If we keep pursuing them in the absence of concrete leads, Smolak may use it as justification to hold on to Zille. Especially after our failure to come to a diplomatic agreement."

1426.speaker: Player_Romus
1426.text: "It worked. We agreed to let the AN handle the issue instead of simply taking what was ours."

1427.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1427.text: "What's more, we could easily delegate this investigation to our already established intelligence unit in Pales without spending an extra cent."

1428.speaker: Hugo Toras
1428.text: "That's very frugal of you, Duchess Azaro. However, I still think you're barking up the wrong tree."

1433.speaker: Hugo Toras
1433.text: "Internationally, this move could strain our relations with not only Pales but the region as a whole."

1434.speaker: Hugo Toras
1434.text: "However, bringing an abrupt halt to the investigation also has its disadvantages. It might signal to others that we are unwilling to pursue justice for a crime committed on another sovereign state."

1438.speaker: Player_Romus
1438.text: "I trust your intelligence, Duchess Azaro. I authorize you to put our Pales special operatives on the case."

1440.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1440.text: "At once, Your Majesty. I promise they'll get results."

1455.speaker: Player_Romus
1455.text: "By the authority vested in me as the King of Rizia, I order you to keep investigating Wehlen. We will get to the bottom of this by any means necessary." [-1 Authority]

1459.speaker: Player_Romus
1459.text: "It's a waste of resources. I doubt Wehlen will be convinced by any of our findings, anyway."

1461.speaker: Player_Romus
1461.text: "I'll be the judge of that. Tell me more about the character of these."

1467.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

1469.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1469.text: "Yes. As per our agreement, Rizia's border forces have been instructed not to allow any Bludish citizens into the kingdom from Wehlen."

1470.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1470.text: "However, it's not a easy task. Our patrol officers have been seeing a surge of migrant ships attempting to cross the Gulf of Moridia."

1474.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1474.text: "Unlike the officers currently enforcing our border ban on Bludish citizens, our naval patrol boats will be authorized to take a more... proactive role in the process."

1481.speaker: Hugo Toras
1481.text: "Workers are still clamoring for improved rights."

1485.speaker: Hugo Toras
1485.text: "There are actions being organized in protest of Rizia's worsening living standards."

1488.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1488.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) == false

1489.speaker: Hugo Toras
1489.text: "The welfare protesters are claiming that the Crown has yet to address their demand for increased health and education funding."
1489.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_RoyalTraditions_Upheld"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_HumanRights_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Protests_Welfare_Happened"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_MonqizProtests_Disperse"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_IncreasedHealthEducationFunds"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

1496.text: "If they set their sights on us, their agents have the potential to destroy us from inside."

1498.speaker: Narrator

1499.speaker: Player_Romus
1499.text: "Then we'd better not let the working man down."

1500.speaker: Player_Romus
1500.text: "Oh, please. A Rizian garbageman has a better life than a Valgslandian chief executive."

1501.speaker: Player_Romus
1501.text: "I expect our security forces to make short work of them before they get the chance."
